Hi Lindsey — thanks for the patience. Attached is a concise cross-walk and recommended path for the POC. Key points below (numbers are USD / month unless noted):

1) Hosted (on-demand public baseline) — estimates based on your projected month-1 consumption (combined prompt+completion = 12M tokens, embeddings = 0.8M units):
   - Generation cost (hosted list): ~$40.48 (prompt) + ~$38.40 (completion) = ~$78.88 / month
   - Embeddings: ~$0.32 / month
   - Note: above are illustrative at list rates; actual bill will include rounding and per-request minimums.

2) Hosted (committed tiers) — recommended commercial offering for Acme POC: 10% discount at 1M–5M, 18% at 5M–20M, 28% at >20M. For your profile (12M) this implies ~18% off hosted list baseline (est. ~ $64/month). We can include a 30–45 day POC credit for the first month to accelerate approvals.

3) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — main deltas: reserved GPU pool + capacity commitment. Rough monthly delta vs hosted (after discount): +$6k–$12k / month depending on desired throughput/SLO. This includes provisioning, sustained throughput guarantees, and data isolation. Breakouts:
   - Reserved infra: $4k–$9k / month (GPU + host infra)
   - Managed ops & SLA uplift: $2k–$3k / month
   - Note: Dedicated reduces per-token variable cost at high volume due to better CPU/GPU amortization; break-even typically at 50–100M tokens/month depending on QPS profile.

4) Private (VPC/on-prem) — typical components: one-time license & onboarding + infra + support uplift. Order-of-magnitude for POC scale:
   - One-time onboarding/license: $40k–$80k (includes entitlements, license, initial install)
   - Monthly infra ops (customer-managed infra estimate): varies widely; if managed by Redwood in customer VPC expect ~$8k–$15k / month for equivalent Dedicated capacity + optional managed support $3k/mo.

5) Recommended path for Acme POC: start Hosted committed with a 30% first-month credit; enable path to Dedicated with a 3-month evaluation that can transition to Dedicated reserved if monthly tokens >50M or if steady-state QPS exceeds 250 with strict SLOs. For Private, show a separate SOW and include a two- or three-person deployment retainer for HIPAA compliance work.

Next steps:
- Please review the attached Crosstab (Pricing_Crosstab_Acme_v1.xlsx) — it contains line-item math and sensitivity to QPS and token mix.
- If this looks reasonable, procurement and legal can start a redline on the SOW/DPA; I'll draft a SOW (Draft_SOW.docx) and route for signature (DocuSign).
